title: decent bags for light duty use, all 100 02 absorbers are packed together, inc labels
text:
decent bags for light duty use, all 100 02 absorbers are packed together, inc labels. 3-4 stars for the bags. 2 for the absorbers if only based on how they are packaged (all together).

Bags are of nice size and thickness, with gussets for standing. Though not as thick and robust as some bags I have. These would be (for me) for short term storage. Think snacks and such that can benefit from "mylar" storage, but maybe not for super long term storage, unless storing these in a container for long storage (think of food grade buckets filled with mylar bags filled with food). You do you though.

I normally dont buy these kits for the oxygen absorbers. For that, I prefer to buy a very trusted brand, since it is all about the 02 absorbers in terms of effectiveness. Cant risk it, and I dont really have a way to test it in a manner that I would/could comfortably do (seal some food, come back a year later and see if it molded, or went bad in another way). But I do appreciate the inclusion of O2 absorbers, and here again I will use them for stuff that I am not concerned about for long term storage. More is better, so feel free to use extra in your bags. So, maybe a batch of cookies I made, or storing some chips, powders, etc.

Yet, I still factor the 02 absorbers into my rating. I consider them "good enough" if they are individually packaged, and pretty much useless if all stored together. Once open, they have all been exposed to air. I'm fine with a handful being in one vac sealed packet, but not all 100. And so, if you buy this for using the whole kit, then plan to use up the 02 absorbers quickly as well. I suppose some can be used, then just tightly packaged the unused ones back up.. but I'm not chancing it.

I wish companies would say if the absorbers are all packed together (unwrapped) or packed together but also individually wrapped. I come across both scenarios and this is the former. Figured I would mention it in case you are looking for that info too (the pic they include doesnt quite clarify).

Overall, the kit is "OK". Which is 3 stars, and means just that-- it is OK. Not great, not bad. Has pros and cons. Will be up to you to decide. I just have my preferences, and it wasnt something I could totally detect from their description or pics alone.
